comparison: Perfect alignment on computational modeling framework (C35-C41). Both evaluations find the four essential quantities and implementation approach well-supported. OpenEval provides detailed citation analysis while peer reviewers praise achievement of 'original vision' for data-driven simulations.

Perfect alignment on external resource integration (C42-C47). Both evaluations support these claims without concern. OpenEval details specific integrations and bidirectional nature, while peer reviewers implicitly affirm through praise of database navigation and accessibility.

Strong alignment on database expansion (C2, C11-C21). Both evaluations support the progressive growth and 100-fold increase claims. OpenEval provides detailed version-by-version analysis, while peer reviewers explicitly praise the expansion summarized in Table 1.

Strong alignment on neuron type refinements (C23-C28). Both evaluations support these specific characterization updates. OpenEval validates individual citations, while peer reviewers implicitly accept through overall praise of expanded resource and methodology.

Strong alignment on resource positioning and evolution (C57-C60, C61-C62). Both evaluations support the distinction from other resources and the transition from data repository to simulation platform. Peer reviewers explicitly affirm this characterization.

Strong alignment on hippocampus model application (C52-C54). Both evaluations support the Kopsick et al. work producing realistic oscillations. OpenEval validates figure evidence, while peer reviewers praise applications as 'exciting' research opportunities.

Strong alignment on usage statistics and community impact (C29-C30, C63-C64, C111-C112). Both evaluations support these metrics. OpenEval notes internal consistency, while peer reviewers explicitly acknowledge resource utility for 'vast hippocampal community.'

Divergent evaluation on future directions (C65-C70). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN due to speculative nature of unrealized applications. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED and enthusiastically praise these as opening 'doors to new and exciting research opportunities.'

Divergent evaluation on future technology integration (C79-C84). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN as forward-looking statements about potential capabilities. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, praising vision for making theoretical models 'experimentally testable.'

Divergent evaluation on grid cell model (C55-C56). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN due to work being 'in preparation' and not yet peer-reviewed. Peer reviewers rate SUPPORTED, acknowledging preliminary nature but praising without criticism.

Strong alignment on independent usage examples (C31-C34). Both evaluations support these demonstrations of real-world utility. OpenEval validates specific citations, while peer reviewers affirm resource helpfulness for community.

Strong alignment on classification framework foundations (C1, C7-C10). Both evaluations support the foundational system. OpenEval validates citations and rationale, while peer reviewers affirm through praise of 'excellent description' and expanded resource.

Strong alignment on GUI functionality (C48-C51). Both evaluations support new interface features and default handling. OpenEval validates methodological rigor, while peer reviewers praise achievement of enabling simulations with literature links.

Strong alignment on distinction between data types (C61-C62). Both evaluations support transparency about direct data versus derived parameters. OpenEval emphasizes methodological credibility, peer reviewers affirm resource evolution.

Strong alignment on key features and applications (C4-C5). Both evaluations support these capability claims. OpenEval validates through demonstrated examples, while peer reviewers affirm applications as credible for diverse computational neuroscience community.

Strong alignment on connectivity computation methodology (C90-C95). Both evaluations support these methods. OpenEval validates citations and transparency of assumptions, while peer reviewers implicitly accept through overall assessment that 'work is convincing.'

Strong alignment on user control and flexibility features (C71-C74). Both evaluations support these design capabilities. OpenEval emphasizes traceability and gap identification, while peer reviewers praise enabling simulations with direct literature links.

Strong alignment on classification principles (C104-C106). Both evaluations support the fundamental framework. OpenEval validates logical basis, while peer reviewers affirm through praise of resource scope and approach.

Strong alignment on versioning and linking methodology (C85-C89). Both evaluations support these procedures. OpenEval validates quality control criteria, while peer reviewers implicitly accept through praise of database navigation ease.

Strong alignment on metadata annotation utility (C76-C78). Both evaluations support these features. OpenEval emphasizes practical utility for parameter translation, while peer reviewers affirm through praise of literature-linked simulations.

Strong alignment on simulation environment (C96-C99). Both evaluations support CARLsim selection and rationale. OpenEval validates citations and logic for scale, while peer reviewers implicitly accept through overall technical assessment.

Strong alignment on technical specifications (C100-C103). Both evaluations support implementation details and open source availability. OpenEval emphasizes reproducibility enhancement, while peer reviewers affirm through ease of navigation assessment.

Strong alignment on neuron type expansion (C3, C22, C107-C108). Both evaluations support the 56 new types in v2.0. OpenEval validates Figure 2 and methodology, while peer reviewers implicitly accept through praise of greatly expanded resource.

Strong alignment on synaptic property data accumulation (C109-C110). Both evaluations support the 500,000 pieces of knowledge claim. OpenEval validates citations and explains normalization context, while peer reviewers affirm data accumulation scope.
